key_provisions_or_claims: Supports Drone Security Package with registration, identification and traceability, especially for micro and nano drones, kept risk-based and proportionate.
Counter-drone measures (jamming, spoofing, kinetic) must undergo aviation safety assessment, certification and ATM/U-space interoperability.
Calls for 'certify once – use EU-wide', sandboxes, and a gradual shift from voluntary to mandatory EU requirements for high-risk operations.
AI-enabled and autonomous systems must keep meaningful human oversight, transparency and accountability.
CCMI opinion urges rapid scale-up of Made in EU drone and counter-drone industrial capacity, the 'drone wall', and secure critical raw materials.
annotation.summary_en: EESC opinion (TEN/883) on the Commission's Action Plan on Drone and Counter-Drone Security, with an annexed CCMI supplementary opinion on industrial and defence readiness. It backs harmonised, risk-based certification, registration and counter-drone safety within aviation, human oversight of AI systems, and stronger EU industrial capacity, dual-use cooperation and funding.
